cost_basis.source: Reprice the maximum observed Phase 8c4b r3 Sonnet easy-tier call at Haiku 4.5 rates.

repair_policy.eligible: Every available initial parse or musical-contract failure, including the named sentinel.
repair_policy.feedback: Return only the structured parse or failed-check diagnostic.
repair_policy.primary_result: Initial musical success only. A repair never replaces an initial result.
repair_policy.unavailable_or_failed: Do not repair and do not add to a scored denominator.

stopping_rule: Return analysis-repair-pass only when all five unique Haiku initial results are scored and the pass rate is 0.20 through 0.80. Otherwise return repair-measurement. Retain the frozen eligible Gemini r3 result.
